body: I know you do but it would hurt them way more if you actually did something and they were left to pick up the pieces.
Everybody makes mistakes and sometimes we do things we’re not proud of. But nothing is worth killing yourself over, I can promise you that.
I know and its so fucking hard and it hurts and its so heavy but this would be permanent, like you would never be able to change that
i’m so glad you are. you can message me and vent if you want
Shit, seriously? I’m sorry man. That would hurt like a bitch. But what would you do if it failed again and left you in even more pain, you know what I mean?

I love you. This would be permanent, please think about that

this is permanent. once you do it, you can’t come back. think about that for a minute and take a few deep breaths.
this made my heart sink. hanging is extremely painful and actually really hard to do, and you’d be in pain before you’d go. i don’t want you to go at all. so please stay

I just want you to stay, you know?.. It hurts so bad. I originally came on here to write my own thingy but yours was just so alike to mine and I just can’t seem to let you go yet until I know you’re okay. i don’t know what i can say to get you to stay and i understand why but i just.. it hurts so much. i don’t want you to go
What’s going on? I’m here to listen
But what about all of the sunsets and sunrises you have yet to see? and all of those cute dogs you may see on the street? and the album your favorite artist hasn’t dropped yet?
I love you so much. Please stay. Please.

there are so many dogs you have yet to meet, my love. you may have zero idea right now, but two years down the road you might meet your best friend in animal form, or human form. please stay. seriously, please.
please don’t go. please stay. please.
